title: Bachelor of Science In Cyber Security- University 1st 2nd year and final year (Level 4 5 and 6 Diploma)
description: Gain expertise in securing digital landscapes and mitigating cybersecurity threats.
longDescription: This programme equips students with a solid foundation in cybersecurity, blending technical and analytical skills to address modern security challenges. Students will explore topics like system security, cyber forensics, cryptography, and ethical hacking while building programming and data analysis expertise. The course emphasizes hands-on experience in safeguarding digital environments, investigating cybercrimes, and developing secure systems. With a focus on real-world applications, learners will be prepared for dynamic roles in cybersecurity. Graduates will gain the skills to protect organizations against evolving digital threats.
courseDetails: Students will delve into the intricacies of computer systems, cybersecurity protocols, and ethical hacking techniques. They will acquire skills in cyber forensics, cryptography, and secure web development. The curriculum integrates mathematical and programming concepts for data analysis and problem-solving. Practical projects and industry-relevant case studies prepare students to address real-world cybersecurity challenges effectively.
courseDetailParagraphs: Students will delve into the intricacies of computer systems, cybersecurity protocols, and ethical hacking techniques. They will acquire skills in cyber forensics, cryptography, and secure web development. The curriculum integrates mathematical and programming concepts for data analysis and problem-solving. Practical projects and industry-relevant case studies prepare students to address real-world cybersecurity challenges effectively.
entry: For entry into Level 4, 5 and Diploma in Cyber Security, learners must possess the following:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Result can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Result. (This is assessed on a case by case basis)
* Learner must be 18 years or older at the start of the Course.
* Mature Learners (21 years or older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up On completion of this course, students have the opportunity to complete a bachelor's degree programme from a range of UK universities. The top-up programme can be studied online or on campus. The top-up comprises the final 120 credits, consisting of either a dissertation or a dissertation and one module. (The course tuition fee listed above already includes the top-up fees) University Progression Click here to see University routes and fee information for progression.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
certificateDetails: You will receive two degrees from GSS Partner Universities.

modules.title: Computers And Security
modules.summary: Provides an overview of computer systems and essential security protocols to protect data and networks from cyber threats.

modules.title: Principles Of Cyber Forensics
modules.summary: Introduces the techniques and processes used to investigate cybercrimes and preserve digital evidence for legal proceedings.

modules.title: Principles Of Programming
modules.summary: Focuses on foundational programming concepts and problem-solving techniques to develop software applications.

modules.title: Maths For Data Science
modules.summary: Explores mathematical concepts, statistical models, and computational techniques essential for data analysis and decision-making in data science.

modules.title: Systems Design
modules.summary: Covers the principles and methodologies for designing scalable and efficient computer systems to meet business and technological requirements.

modules.title: Web Development
modules.summary: Teaches the development of dynamic and responsive websites using modern web technologies and frameworks.

modules.title: Data Analytics
modules.summary: Explores the tools and techniques used to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and derive insights for informed decision-making.

modules.title: Operating Systems
modules.summary: Examines the core principles of operating systems, focusing on process management, memory allocation, and file systems.

modules.title: Cryptography & Security
modules.summary: Introduces cryptographic techniques and security protocols to protect sensitive information and ensure secure communication.

modules.title: Network Design & Configuration
modules.summary: Focuses on the principles of designing and configuring secure and efficient computer networks for organizational needs.

modules.title: Ethical Hacking & Security
modules.summary: Explores ethical hacking methodologies to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and implement security measures in systems and networks.

modules.title: Artificial Intelligence
modules.summary: Provides an introduction to artificial intelligence concepts, including machine learning, neural networks, and their applications in problem-solving.

modules.title: Cyber Human Factors
modules.summary: Investigates the human aspects of cybersecurity, including user behavior, cognitive biases, and their impact on security practices.

modules.title: Computing Technology Placement
modules.summary: Offers practical experience through industry placements, allowing students to apply their computing skills in real-world settings.

modules.title: Advanced Networking & Security
modules.summary: Focuses on advanced networking concepts, protocols, and security measures to protect complex network infrastructures from evolving threats.

outcomes: Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of computer systems and security protocols to safeguard information assets and mitigate cybersecurity risks.
Apply principles of cyber forensics to investigate digital crimes, collect evidence, and maintain the integrity of forensic procedures.
Develop, test, and debug software solutions by utilizing foundational programming concepts and techniques.
Utilize mathematical models and statistical tools to analyze data, solve problems, and support decision-making in data science applications.
Design and evaluate system architectures to optimize performance, reliability, and scalability in various computing environments.
Create and maintain dynamic, user-friendly websites by leveraging modern web development technologies and best practices.
Analyze data sets to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights using advanced data analytics tools and techniques.

Demonstrate knowledge of operating system concepts, including process management, memory allocation, and file systems, to optimize system performance. Explore the principles of cryptography and security to design secure communication systems and protect sensitive information.
Evaluate ethical hacking techniques to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and propose solutions to strengthen organizational cybersecurity.
